note: Thresholds and outcome rules for Paths E/F/G. Written before bench_efg.py was first run; any later edit must be recorded in QUANTUM_SIMULATION_RESEARCH.md as an amendment, never silently. Outcome vocabulary: PROMOTE_OPT_IN | RESEARCH_ONLY. Default is RESEARCH_ONLY; PROMOTE_OPT_IN requires EVERY criterion of the path to be met.

seeds.rule: Thresholds are evaluated on held-out seeds only. Development seeds are used for debugging and may not be used for a claim.

hard_correctness.E-H1: amplitude <x|C|0> and Z-string expectation agree with the dense oracle to abs error <= 1e-10 for every strategy on every tiny case (n <= 12)
hard_correctness.E-H2: amplitudes also agree with Qiskit Statevector to <= 1e-10 on >= 20 cases (independent engine)

criteria.E-1: on >= 2 of the 3 families, best geometry-aware strategy (geometry_sweep or greedy) has largest intermediate tensor log2-elements at least 2 bits below the time-ordered sequential baseline, median over held-out seeds
criteria.E-2: on the same families, total contraction FLOPs (2^legs-union summed) at least 4x lower than sequential baseline, median over held-out seeds
criteria.E-3: on no family is the selected strategy more than 1 bit worse than sequential baseline in largest tensor
criteria.E-4: report (not gate) Path C max bond chi on the same circuits
criteria.E-5: sampling convergence (TV vs bond/cut dimension) demonstrated. The prototype does not implement sampling; E-5 is therefore NOT_IMPLEMENTED and the maximum outcome for Path E in W7 is RESEARCH_ONLY.

hard_correctness.F-H1: with chi_max=None and Kraus unraveling, N->infinity limit is the density-matrix result: verified by exact enumeration identity sum_k K_k^dag K_k = I per channel and by statistical agreement below
hard_correctness.F-H2: noiseless trajectory run equals the dense statevector to <= 1e-10

criteria.F-1: empirical coverage of the simultaneous normal-approximation CI (alpha=0.05, Bonferroni over 2^n outcomes) >= 0.90 over R=60 repetitions with N=400 on each workload, held-out seeds
criteria.F-2: log-log slope of mean TV vs N on the ladder N in {25,50,100,200,400,800,1600} lies in [-0.65, -0.35] (Monte-Carlo 1/sqrt(N) = -0.5)
criteria.F-3: with chi_max=None accumulated discarded weight <= 1e-12 on every trajectory (error separation: truncation error is zero; reported statistical error is purely stochastic)
criteria.F-4: ADVANTAGE: on at least one workload with n <= 6, total trajectory wall time to reach TV<=0.02 (smallest N on the ladder that does so, held-out median) is lower than the density-matrix backend wall time for the same circuit. For n <= 6 the exact density matrix is cheap, so this is expected to FAIL; the failure is the recorded result.
criteria.F-5: informational: variance ratio rotated/kraus unraveling; no effect on outcome

hard_correctness.G-H1: with no truncation, MPE state equals dense statevector of the same circuit up to infidelity <= 1e-10 on all tiny cases
hard_correctness.G-H2: Trotterised circuit vs exact expm(-iHt) error is reported separately (Trotter error) from MPE truncation error and floating-point error

criteria.G-1: over (family, depth, chi) cells in which truncation is active for either method and the MPS baseline infidelity > 1e-12, MPE infidelity <= 0.5 x MPS infidelity in >= 50 percent of cells, in BOTH families (held-out seeds)
criteria.G-2: product initial state only; post-selection and highly entangled initial states are NOT implemented, so the paper's advantage regime (post-selection) is untested; a G-1 failure is recorded as a loss on the tested regime, not a refutation of the paper

router: Default router is unchanged. A test asserts VALID_PATHS == (A,B,C,D), that no plan candidate or executed path is E/F/G, and that no cqhecs module imports research prototypes.
